name: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search
tip: One request covers all four sites. Enter your email, tap the link they email you, enter your date of birth, then find your record and suppress it.

name: BeenVerified and PeopleLooker
tip: Search your name, pick your record and submit the opt-out with your email. Finish with the link they email you.

name: Enformion (supplies people-search sites)
tip: A data supplier behind several people-search sites. Complete its opt-out request form.

name: Acxiom (data wholesaler)
tip: Supplies marketing data to other brokers. Fill in the opt-out form with your name, address and email.

name: Epsilon (data wholesaler)
tip: Choose the opt-out or delete request and complete the form.

name: LexisNexis (data wholesaler)
tip: Feeds many background-check services. Use the request form and choose to opt out or delete.

name: Data Axle (data wholesaler)
tip: Complete the privacy rights request and choose delete or do not sell.

name: CoreLogic / Cotality (property data)
tip: Property and address data. Use the privacy portal to request deletion or opt out.

name: Melissa (address data)
tip: Complete the consumer privacy form to opt out.

name: Versium (data wholesaler)
tip: Complete the opt-out form.

name: LiveRamp (identity data)
tip: Use the privacy choices page to opt out or request deletion.

name: ZoomInfo (work contacts)
tip: Sells work contact details. Verify your email, then remove your profile.

name: RocketReach (work contacts)
tip: Sells work contact details. Request removal of your profile.

name: Apollo.io (work contacts)
tip: Sells work contact details. Request removal with your email.

name: Lusha (work contacts)
tip: Sells work contact details. Request removal with your email.

name: Checksecrets
tip: Search your name on this page and opt out of any record that is you.

name: National Cellular Directory
tip: Phone lookup site. Complete the opt-out form.

name: Quick Public Records
tip: Complete the privacy request to suppress your listing.

name: SearchPublicRecords
tip: Complete the privacy request to suppress your listing.

name: OurStates
tip: Complete the opt-out form.

name: Sync.me (caller ID)
tip: Caller ID lookup. Enter your phone number to remove it.
